**Profile:** CurrentLineItem (Current Line Item)\
**Attribute:** Qty\
**Data Type:** integer\
**Sub-Attribute:** NA\
**Operator:** <,>,<=,>=,==\

**Syntax: currentLineItem.qty\[Operators]\[VALUE]**\
